svg.title: Naive implementation: inputs, query executions, and results
svg.desc: initial inputs; a: 2 words, includes b; b: 3 words · c: 2 words. Printed calls: is_haha_number(a), word_count(a), word_count(b). Result: false. b.text changed; "red blue green"; 3 → 3 words. Printed calls: is_haha_number(a), word_count(a), word_count(b). Result: false. b.text changed; 3 → 65 words. Printed calls: is_haha_number(a), word_count(a), word_count(b). Result: true. b.text changed; 65 → 67 words. Printed calls: is_haha_number(a), word_count(a), word_count(b). Result: true. a.includes changed; b → c. Printed calls: is_haha_number(a), word_count(a), word_count(c). Result: false. Arrows show printed call order, not dependencies or individual query return values.
